customers.evidence: our commitment to the highest quality coffee in the world

community.evidence: we've tried to make it a little better than we found it

result.analyst_notes: Warm, aspirational tone built on a single customer moment and the idea of connection. Uses first-person plural throughout. Pairs an absolute claim ('we make sure everything we do honors that connection') with hedged effort ('we've tried'). Customers and communities are addressed first; employees, shareholders and environment are absent. Commitments are general and unquantified.
